description: A photographed manufactured brick-built bonsai sculpture: brown segmented plastic trunk and branches, pink and pale plastic blossoms, black rectangular planter with pebbles, and a brown slatted stand on draped purple textured cloth. A stationary red bicycle, dark furniture, keyboard and room objects sit behind it.
cameraIntent: Begin at the photographed view. Make a restrained close arc with a slight lift, revealing the branch and planter depth while preserving the entire sculpture and the layered indoor background.
invariants: The subject is a rigid brick/plastic sculpture, not a living tree.
Blossoms, trunk, planter, stand, cloth, and background bicycle remain static.
Preserve the pink blossoms, brown trunk, black planter, purple cloth and red bicycle.

normalization.operation: EXIF orientation, centered uniform cover crop to exact aspect ratio; no stretching or generative editing
